gen-dafont-visitor-gf-suwannaphum: Nostalgic from the first glance, Visitor draws heavy strokes like neon glass tubing. Suwannaphum, a dignified text serif, is far lighter in weight, with high lowercase and a wide-open c.
gen-dafont-visitor-inter: Nostalgic, digital punch: Visitor gapes at the e and pulls its strokes like solder through a nozzle, short ascenders over big bowls. Inter, a sans with tube-smooth lines, rewards a generous body size.
gen-dafont-visitor-mulish: Digital through and through, Visitor gapes wide at every e. Mulish, a sans-serif with unmodulated strokes and horseshoe-open apertures, gives that nostalgic mouthful a modern, approachable counterweight alongside it.
gen-dafont-woodgod-bitter: Commanding right away, Woodgod cuts a wide channel into every bowl and lets its lowercase nearly touch the capitals. Bitter, a grounded slab-serif, carries paragraphs with a very large lowercase eye.
gen-dafont-woodgod-fs-bespoke-sans: Woodgod comes in commanding, its lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals. Bespoke Sans, a sans with generous room where curves meet the stem, stands moderate in height and tames the vintage loudness.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-piazzolla: A wide channel cut into every bowl marks Woodgod at once. Piazzolla, a text serif whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals, opens its e like a pried clasp and adds refined authority beside it.
gen-eater-gf-anek-gujarati: Dark, aggressive and widely spaced, Eater keeps its ascenders short and its stems moderately weighty, while Anek Gujarati does the reading, clean and approachable, with lowercase rivaling the capitals.
gen-eater-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Dark and aggressive, Eater spaces its letters wide with short ascenders and curves heavier than its joins. Anek Gurmukhi steps in with big counters in every small letter, so the dark heading never crowds the text.
gen-eater-gf-anek-odia: Aggressive by temperament, Eater draws medium-low stress between stem and hairline, with wide gaps between letters. Eater makes the statement; Anek Odia, a sans, handles reading with unsealed rounds.
gen-eater-gf-anek-telugu: Dark, aggressive Eater spaces its letters wide. Anek Telugu, a sans-serif with wide, tall bowls that stay unsealed like an unlatched hook, feels clean and approachable beside it.
